amendment_reason: Independent V2 re-review deterministically replaced a path with a different inode carrying byte-identical manifest payload after revalidation lstat but before path.read_bytes. The existing revalidation accepted because it did not bind the opened handle identity or perform a post-read path lstat. This is a pre-outcome integrity fix only; no Stage0 live output or market outcome exists.

required_fix.contract: Every capture and every revalidation read must open one binary file handle without following a reparse alias, fstat that handle before reading, read the payload from that exact handle, fstat the same handle after reading, and lstat the lexical path after reading. Require path-before lstat identity == handle-before fstat identity == handle-after fstat identity == path-after lstat identity == the original verified snapshot identity. Also require size, SHA and payload equality where applicable. Never use Path.read_bytes or reopen by path inside the identity-critical read. Fail before decode acceptance or output publication on any mismatch.

red_first_acceptance_tests: Deterministically swap the path to a new inode with byte-identical manifest payload after the initial revalidation lstat but before the read. Revalidation and full decode_verified_snapshot must fail.
Mutate the opened file after handle-before fstat but before/during read; handle-after fstat or payload/hash checks must fail.
Swap the path after the handle read but before path-after lstat; identity checks must fail.
Unchanged normal file passes and the exact payload supplied to DBNStore.from_bytes remains manifest-bound.
All 44 V2 tests plus V3 adversarial tests pass in the dedicated runtime; no live 658-file run or final output occurs.
